zh: 总件数除以 C 向上取整、最大类别件数除以 L 向上取整，都是车辆数的显然下界。
包裹可以逐件独立分配，一类可以分散到多辆车；只要车数同时满足这两个下界，就总能凑出每车总量不超过 C、每类不超过 L 的装法，所以答案就是两者较大值。
读入时累加总件数并记录最大类别件数；分别计算 ⌈总数/C⌉ 和 ⌈最大值/L⌉，输出较大者；全部为 0 时两项都为 0。总数可达 2×10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: The total count divided by C rounded up and the largest category divided by L rounded up are both obvious lower bounds on the number of trucks.

Packages are assigned one by one and a category may be spread over many trucks; whenever the number of trucks meets both bounds, a loading with at most C per truck and at most L per category per truck always exists, so the answer is the larger bound.

While reading, sum the counts and track the largest category; compute ceil(total/C) and ceil(max/L) and output the larger; when everything is 0 both terms are 0. The total can reach 2*10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The answer is the larger of the total count divided by C rounded up and the largest category count divided by L rounded up.

## Proof of correctness

Both terms are obviously lower bounds. Let the number of trucks m satisfy both. In the network where each category sends to every truck with capacity L and each truck sends to the sink with capacity C, everything can be loaded: for any subset S of categories, the required amount sum(S) <= min(total, |S|*m*L) <= m*min(C, |S|*L), which satisfies the cut condition of the complete bipartite capacity network. An integral flow gives a valid item-by-item loading, so the lower bound suffices.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n) including the input; the answer uses 64-bit integers.
